briefdescription.para: The instance of the TMR_Manager Device.
This function does a minimal test on the TMR_Manager device and driver as a design example.

detaileddescription.para: The purpose of this function is to illustrate how to use the XTMR_Manager component.
This function sends data through the TMR_Manager.
This function uses the interrupt driver mode of the TMR_Manager. The calls to the TMR_Manager driver in the interrupt handlers, should only use the non-blocking calls.

TMR_ManagerInstPtr
is a pointer to the instance of the TMR_Manager driver.
BaseAddress
is the base address of the TMR_Manager device.
XST_SUCCESS if successful, otherwise XST_FAILURE. This function contains an infinite loop such that if interrupts are not working it may never return.

briefdescription.para: This function is the handler which performs processing of the TMR_Manager events.

detaileddescription.para: It is called from an interrupt context such that the amount of processing performed should be minimized. It is called when any event that is not masked occurs.
This handler provides an example of how to handle data for the TMR_Manager, but is application specific.

parameterdescription.para: contains a callback reference from the driver, in this case it is the instance pointer for the TMR_Manager driver.

briefdescription.para: Main function to call the TMR_Manager interrupt example.
This file contains a design example using the TMR_Manager driver and hardware device using the interrupt mode for transmission of data.
